verses.geez:
ወመጽአ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ወነገሮ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ አቡየ ፡ ወአኀዊየ ፡ ወእንስሳሆሙ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ንዋዮሙ ፡ መጽኡ ፡
                  እምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ወናሁ ፡ በጽሑ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ጌሴም ።
verses.translation: And Joseph came and told Pharao, saying, My father, and my brethren, and their cattle, and their oxen, and all their possessions, are come out of the land of Chanaan, and, behold, they are in the land of Gesem.

translations.lxx: And Joseph came and told Pharao, saying, My father, and my brethren, and their cattle, and their oxen, and all their possessions, are come out of the land of Chanaan, and, behold, they are in the land of Gesem.
translations.kjv: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.
translations.ron: Mergând deci Iosif a vestit pe Faraon, zicând: "Tatăl meu şi fraţii mei, cu vitele lor mărunte şi mari şi cu toate câte au, au venit din pământul Canaan şi iată sunt în ţinutul Goşen!"
translations.grk: Ἐλθῶν δὲ Ἰωσὴφ ἀπήγγειλε τῷ Φαραῶ, λέγων, ὁ πατὴρ μου, καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί μου, καὶ τὰ κτήνη, καὶ οἱ βόες αὐτῶν, καὶ πάντα τὰ αὐτῶν, ἦλθον ἐκ γῆς Χαναάν· καὶ ἰδού εἰσιν ἐν γῇ Γεσέμ.

verses.geez: ወነሥአ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ እምአኀዊሁ ፡ ኀምስተ ፡ ዕደው ፡ ወአብጽሖሙ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ፈርዖን ።
verses.translation: And he took of his brethren five men, and set them before Pharao.

translations.lxx: And he took of his brethren five men, and set them before Pharao.
translations.kjv: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
translations.ron: Luând apoi pe cinci dintre fraţii săi, i-a înfăţişat lui Faraon.
translations.grk: Ἀπὸ δὲ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ παρέλαβε πέντε ἄνδρας, καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτοὺς ἐναντίον Φαραώ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ለአኀዊሁ ፡ ለዮሴፍ ፡ ምንት ፡ ተግባርክሙ ፤ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ ኖሎተ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ንሕነ ፡
                  አግብርቲከ ፡ ንሕነሂ ፡ ወአበዊነሂ ።
verses.translation: And Pharao said to the brethren of Joseph, What is your occupation? and they said to Pharao, Thy servants are shepherds, both we and our fathers.

translations.lxx: And Pharao said to the brethren of Joseph, What is your occupation? and they said to Pharao, Thy servants are shepherds, both we and our fathers.
translations.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.
translations.ron: Iar Faraon a zis către fraţii lui Iosif: "Cu ce vă îndeletniciţi voi?" Şi ei au răspuns lui Faraon: "Robii tăi sunt un neam de păstori de oi, din tată în fiu".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Φαραὼ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς Ἰωσὴφ, Τί τὸ ἔργον ὑμῶν; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν τῷ Φαραῷ, ποιμένες προβάτων οἱ παῖδές σου, καὶ ἡμεῖς καὶ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν.

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ አኅድረነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀበ ፡ መጻእነ ፡ እስመ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ምርዓየ ፡ ለእንስሳ
                  ፡ አግብርቲከ ፡ ወዐብየ ፡ ረኃብ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፤ ወይእዜኒ ፡ አኅድር ፡ አግብርቲከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ጌሴም
                  ።
verses.translation: And they said to Pharao, We are come to sojourn in the land, for there is no pasture for the flocks of thy servants, for the famine has prevailed in the land of Chanaan; now then, we will dwell in the land of Gesem. And Pharao said to Joseph, Let them dwell in the land of Gesem; and if thou knowest that there are among them able men, make them overseers of my cattle. So Jacob and his sons came into Egypt, to Joseph; and Pharao, king of Egypt, heard of it.

translations.lxx: And they said to Pharao, We are come to sojourn in the land, for there is no pasture for the flocks of thy servants, for the famine has prevailed in the land of Chanaan; now then, we will dwell in the land of Gesem. And Pharao said to Joseph, Let them dwell in the land of Gesem; and if thou knowest that there are among them able men, make them overseers of my cattle. So Jacob and his sons came into Egypt, to Joseph; and Pharao, king of Egypt, heard of it.
translations.kjv: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
translations.ron: Apoi au zis iarăşi către Faraon: "Am venit să locuim în pământul acesta, căci nu se găseşte păşune pentru vitele robilor tăi, pentru că în ţara Canaan e foamete mare. îngăduie dar robilor tăi să se aşeze în ţinutul Goşen!"
translations.grk: Εἶπαν δὲ τῷ Φαραῷ, παροικεῖν ἐν τῇ γῇ ἥκαμεν, οὐ γάρ ἐστι νομὴ τοῖς κτήνεσι τῶν παιδων σου, ἐνίσχυσε γὰρ ὁ λιμὸς ἐν γῇ Χανάαν· νῦν οὖν κατοικήσομεν ἐν γῇ Γεσέμ. Εἶπε δὲ Φαραὼ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ, Κατοικείτωσαν ἐν γῇ Γεσέμ· εἰ δὲ ἐπίστῃ, ὅτι εἰσὶν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἄνδρες δυνατοὶ, κατάστησον αὐτοὺς ἄρχοντας τῶν ἐμῶν κτηνῶν. Ἦλθον δὲ εἰς Αἴγυπτον πρὸς Ἰωσὴφ Ἰακὼβ, καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἤκουσε Φαραὼ βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ለዮሴፍ ፡ እስመ ፡ መጽኡ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ወአኀዊከ ፡ ኀቤከ ፤
verses.translation: And Pharao spoke to Joseph, saying, Thy father, and thy brethren, are come to thee.

translations.lxx: And Pharao spoke to Joseph, saying, Thy father, and thy brethren, are come to thee.
translations.kjv: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:
translations.ron: Iar Faraon a zis către Iosif: "Tatăl tău şi fraţii tăi au venit la tine.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Φαραὼ πρὸς Ἰωσὴφ, λέγων, ὁ πατήρ σου, καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί σου, ἥκασι πρὸς σέ.

verses.geez:
ናሁ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ቅድሜከ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትኄይስ ፡ ይኅድሩ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ወአኀዊከ ፡ ወእመሰ ፡ ቦቱ
                  ፡ እለ ፡ ታአምር ፡ ከመ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ጽኑዓነ ፡ በውስቴቶሙ ፡ ዕደወ ፡ ሢሞሙ ፡ መላእክተ ፡ ኖሎት ፡ ለእንስሳየ ።
verses.translation: Behold, the land of Egypt is before thee; settle thy father and thy brethren in the best land.

translations.lxx: Behold, the land of Egypt is before thee; settle thy father and thy brethren in the best land.
translations.kjv: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.
translations.ron: Iată, pământul Egiptului îţi stă înainte; aşează pe tatăul tău şi pe fraţii tăi în cel mai bun loc din ţară. Să locuiască ei în pământul Goşen, şi de cunoşti printre ei oameni pricepuţi, pune-i supreveghetori peste vitele mele!"
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ ἡ γῆ Αἰγύπτου ἐναντίον σου ἐστίν· ἐν τῇ βελτίστῃ γῇ κατοίκισον τὸν πατέρα σου, καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου.

verses.geez: ወአምጽኦ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ ወአቀሞ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ወባረኮ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ለፈርዖን ።
verses.translation: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharao; and Jacob blessed Pharao.

translations.lxx: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharao; and Jacob blessed Pharao.
translations.kjv: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
translations.ron: Apoi a adus Iosif înăuntru pe Iacov, tatăl său, şi l-a înfăţişat înaintea lui Faraon şi a binecuvântat Iacov pe Faraon;
translations.grk: Εἰσήγαγε δὲ Ἰωσὴφ Ἰακὼβ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτὸν ἐναντίον Φαραώ· καὶ ηὐλόγησεν Ἰακὼβ τὸν Φαραώ.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ ሚመጠን ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ዘሐየውከ ።
verses.translation: And Pharao said to Jacob, How many are the years of the days of thy life?

translations.lxx: And Pharao said to Jacob, How many are the years of the days of thy life?
translations.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?
translations.ron: Iar Faraon a zis către Iacov: "Câţi sunt anii vieţii tale?"
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Φαραὼ τῷ Ἰακὼβ, πόσα ἔτη ἡμερῶν τῆς ζωῆς σου;

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ሕይወትየሰ ፡ ዘሐየውኩ ፡ ምእት ፡ ወሠላሳ ፡ እማንቱ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ሕዳጥ ፡
                  ወእኩያተ ፡ ኮናኒ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ሕይወትየ ፡ ወዓመትየኒ ፡ ወኢከመ ፡ ምንት ፡ ኮናኒ ፡ በኀበ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ አበዊየ ፡ ዘሐይዉ
                  ።
verses.translation: And Jacob said to Pharao, The days of the years of my life, wherein I sojourn, are a hundred and thirty years; few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, they have not attained to the days of the life of my fathers, in which days they sojourned.

translations.lxx: And Jacob said to Pharao, The days of the years of my life, wherein I sojourn, are a hundred and thirty years; few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, they have not attained to the days of the life of my fathers, in which days they sojourned.
translations.kjv: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
translations.ron: Răspuns-a Iacov lui Faraon: "Zilele pribegiei mele sunt o sută treizeci de ani. Puţine şi grele au fost zilele vieţii mele şi n-am ajuns zilele anilor vieţii părinţilor mei, cât au pribegit ei în zilele lor".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἰακὼβ τῷ Φαραῷ, αἱ ἡμέραι τῶν ἐτῶν τῆς ζωῆς μου, ἃς παροικῶ, ἑκατὸν τριάκοντα ἔτη· μικραὶ καὶ πονηραὶ γεγόνασιν αἱ ἡμέραι τῶν ἐτῶν τῆς ζωῆς μου· οὐκ ἀφίκοντο εἰς τὰς ἡμέρας τῶν ἐτῶν τῆς ζῶης τῶν πατέρων μου, ἃς ἡμέρας παρῴκησαν.

verses.geez: ወሶበ ፡ ባረኮ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ ወፅአ ፡ እምኀቤሁ ።
verses.translation: And Jacob blessed Pharao, and departed from him.

translations.lxx: And Jacob blessed Pharao, and departed from him.
translations.kjv: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.
translations.ron: Şi iarăşi a binecuvântat Iacov pe Faraon şi a ieşit de la Faraon.
translations.grk: Καὶ εὐλογήσας Ἰακὼβ τὸν Φαραὼ, ἐξῆλθεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወአኅደሮሙ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ ወለአኀዊሁ ፡ ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ምኵናነ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትኄይስ ፡
                  ምድር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ [ራምሴ ፡] ዘአዘዘ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ፈርዖን ።
verses.translation: And Joseph settled his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best land, in the land of Ramesses, as Pharao commanded.

translations.lxx: And Joseph settled his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best land, in the land of Ramesses, as Pharao commanded.
translations.kjv: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
translations.ron: Deci a aşezat Iosif pe tatăl său şi pe fraţii săi şi le-a dat moşie în ţara Egiptului, în cea mai bună parte a ţării, în pământul Ramses (Goşen), cum îi poruncise Faraon.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατῴκισεν Ἰωσὴφ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ, καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς κατάσχεσιν ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ, ἐν τῇ βελτίστῃ γῇ, ἐν γῇ Ῥαμεσσῆ, καθὰ προσέταξε Φαραώ.

verses.geez:
ወዮሴፍ ፡ ይሰፍር ፡ ስርናየ ፡ ሲሳየ ፡ [ለ]አቡሁ ፡ ወለአኀዊሁ ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡ ቤተ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ለለ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ነፍስ ፡
                  ይሰፍር ፡ ሲሳየ ፡ ስርናየ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph gave provision to his father, and his brethren, and to all the house of his father, corn for each person.

translations.lxx: And Joseph gave provision to his father, and his brethren, and to all the house of his father, corn for each person.
translations.kjv: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.
translations.ron: Şi dădea Iosif tatălui său şi fraţilor săi şi la toată casa tatălui său pâine după trebuinţa familiei fiecăruia.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐσιτομέτρει Ἰωσὴφ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς, καὶ παντὶ τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ, σῖτον κατὰ σῶμα.

verses.geez:
ወአልቦ ፡ ስርናየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዐብየ ፡ ረኃብ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ወኀልቀ ፡ በረኃብ ፡ ብሔረ ፡
                  ግብጽ ፡ ወከናአን ።
verses.translation: And there was no corn in all the land, for the famine prevailed greatly; and the land of Egypt, and the land of Chanaan, fainted for the famine.

translations.lxx: And there was no corn in all the land, for the famine prevailed greatly; and the land of Egypt, and the land of Chanaan, fainted for the famine.
translations.kjv: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
translations.ron: În vremea aceea nu era pâine în tot pământul, pentru că se înteţise foametea foarte tare, încât ţara Egiptului şi pământul Canaan se istoviseră de foamete.
translations.grk: Σῖτος δὲ οὐκ ἦν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ, ἐνίσχυσε γὰρ ὁ λιμὸς σφόδρα· ἐξέλιπε δὲ ἡ γῆ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἡ γῆ Χαναὰν ἀπὸ τοῦ λιμοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወአስተጋብአ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ወርቀ ፡ ዘአምጽኡ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወሰብአ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ሤጠ ፡ እክል ፡ ዘሤጠ ፡
                  ሎሙ ፡ ወአብአ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ወርቀ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ፈርዖን ።
verses.translation: And Joseph gathered all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and the land of Chanaan, in return for the corn which they bought, and he distributed corn to them; and Joseph brought all the money into the house of Pharao.

translations.lxx: And Joseph gathered all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and the land of Chanaan, in return for the corn which they bought, and he distributed corn to them; and Joseph brought all the money into the house of Pharao.
translations.kjv: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
translations.ron: Şi a adunat Iosif tot argintul, ce era în ţara Egiptului şi în ţara Canaanului, pe grâul ce se cumpăra; de la el. Şi a adus Iosif argintul tot în casa lui Faraon.
translations.grk: Συνήγαγε δὲ Ἰωσὴφ πᾶν τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ εὑρεθὲν ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐν γῇ Χαναὰν, τοῦ σίτου, οὗ ἠγόραζον, καὶ ἐσιτομέτρει αὐτοῖς, καὶ εἰσήνεγκεν Ἰωσὴφ πᾶν τὸ ἀργύριον εἰς τὸν οἶκον Φαραώ.

verses.geez:
ወኀልቀ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ዘብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወዘብሔረ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ወመጽኡ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ዮሴፍ
                  ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ሀበነ ፡ እክለ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢንሙት ፡ በቅድሜከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀልቀ ፡ ወርቅነ ።
verses.translation: And all the money failed out of the land of Egypt, and out of the land of Chanaan; and all the Egyptians came to Joseph, saying, Give us bread, and why do we die in thy presence? for our money is spent.

translations.lxx: And all the money failed out of the land of Egypt, and out of the land of Chanaan; and all the Egyptians came to Joseph, saying, Give us bread, and why do we die in thy presence? for our money is spent.
translations.kjv: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.
translations.ron: Când s-a sfârşit tot argintul în ţara Egiptului şi în ţara Canaanului, au venit atunci toţi Egiptenii la Iosif şi au zis: "Dă-ne pâine! De ce să murim sub ochii tăi? Că s-a sfârşit argintul".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξέλιπε πᾶν τὸ ἀργύριον ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐκ γῆς Χαναάν· ἦλθον δὲ πάντες οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι πρὸς Ἰωσὴφ, λέγοντες, δὸς ἡμῖν ἄρτους, καὶ ἱνατί ἀποθνήσκομεν ἐναντίον σου; ἐκλέλοιπε γὰρ τὸ ἀργύριον ἡμῶν.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ አምጽኡ ፡ እንስሳክሙ ፡ ወአሀብክሙ ፡ እክለ ፡ ህየንተ ፡ እንስሳክሙ ፡ እመ ፡ ኀልቀ ፡ ወርቅክሙ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph said to them, Bring your cattle, and I will give you bread for your cattle, if your money is spent.

translations.lxx: And Joseph said to them, Bring your cattle, and I will give you bread for your cattle, if your money is spent.
translations.kjv: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
translations.ron: Iar Iosif le-a zis: "Aduceţi vitele voastre şi vă voi da pâine pe vitele voastre, dacă vi s-a terminat argintul".
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ αὐτοῖς Ἰωσὴφ, φέρετε τὰ κτήνη ὑμῶν, καὶ δώσω ὑμῖν ἄρτους, ἀντὶ τῶν κτηνῶν ὑμῶν, εἰ ἐκλέλοιπε τὸ ἀργύριον ὑμῶν.

verses.geez:
ወአምጽኡ ፡ እንስሳሆሙ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ወወሀቦሙ ፡ እክለ ፡ ህየንተ ፡ አባግዒሆሙ ፡ ወአልህምቲሆሙ ፡ ወህየንተ ፡
                  አእዱጊሆሙ ፡ ሴሰዮሙ ፡ እክለ ፡ በይእቲ ፡ ዓመት ።
verses.translation: And they brought their cattle to Joseph; and Joseph gave them bread in return for their horses, and for their sheep, and for their oxen, and for their asses; and Joseph maintained them with bread for all their cattle in that year.

translations.lxx: And they brought their cattle to Joseph; and Joseph gave them bread in return for their horses, and for their sheep, and for their oxen, and for their asses; and Joseph maintained them with bread for all their cattle in that year.
translations.kjv: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.
translations.ron: Şi au adus ei la Iosif vitele lor şi le-a dat Iosif pâine pe cai şi pe oi, pe boi şi pe asini; şi anul acela i-a hrănit cu pâine pentru toate vitele lor.
translations.grk: Ἤγαγον δὲ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν πρὸς Ἰωσήφ· καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς Ἰωσὴφ ἄρτους ἀντὶ τῶν ἵππων, καὶ ἀντὶ τῶν προβάτων, καὶ ἀντὶ τῶν βοῶν, καὶ ἀντὶ τῶν ὄνων· καὶ ἐξέθρεψεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἄρτοις ἀντὶ πάντων τῶν κτηνῶν αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ ἐκείνῳ.

verses.geez:
ወኀልቀት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ወመጽኡ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ በካልእት ፡ ዓመት ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢንሙት ፡ ወኢንኅለቅ ፡
                  ለእግዚእነ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተወድአ ፡ ወርቅነሂ ፡ ወንዋይነሂ ፡ ወእንስሳነሂ ፡ ወአኅለቅናሁ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡
                  ዘተረፈ ፡ ለነ ፡ በቅድሜከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ሥጋነ ፡ ዘዚአነ ፡ ወምድርነ ።
verses.translation: And that year passed, and they came to him in the second year, and said to him, Must we then be consumed from before our lord? for if our money has failed, and our possessions, and our cattle, brought to thee our lord, and there has not been left to us before our lord more than our own bodies and our land, we are indeed destitute.

translations.lxx: And that year passed, and they came to him in the second year, and said to him, Must we then be consumed from before our lord? for if our money has failed, and our possessions, and our cattle, brought to thee our lord, and there has not been left to us before our lord more than our own bodies and our land, we are indeed destitute.
translations.kjv: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
translations.ron: Iar dacă a trecut anul acela, au venit în anul următor şi i-au zis: "Nu vom ascunde de domnul nostru, că argintul nostru s-a sfârşit şi vitele noastre sunt la domnul nostru şi nimic nu ne-a mai rămas să-i dăm decât trupurile şi pământurile noastre.
translations.grk: Ἐξῆλθε δὲ τὸ ἔτος ἐκεῖνο, καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ δευτέρῳ, καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ, μή ποτε ἐκτριβῶμεν ἀπὸ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν; εἰ γὰρ ἐκλέλοιπε τὸ ἀργύριον ἡμῶν, καὶ τὰ ὑπάρχοντα καὶ τὰ κτήνη πρός σε τὸν κύριον, καὶ οὐχ ὑπολέλειπται ἡμῖν ἐναντίον τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν, ἀλλʼ ἢ τὸ ἴδιον σῶμα καὶ ἡ γῆ ἡμῶν,

verses.geez:
ከመ ፡ ኢንሙት ፡ እንከ ፡ በቅድሜከ ፡ ወምድርነኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትማስን ፡ ንሥአነ ፡ ወአጥርየነ ፡ ኪያነሂ ፡ ወምድረነሂ ፡
                  ህየንተ ፡ እክል ፡ ወንኩን ፡ አግብርተ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ ወምድርነሂ ፡ ትኩን ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወሀበነ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ወንዝራእ ፡ ከመ ፡
                  ንሕየው ፡ ወኢንሙት ፡ ወምድርነሂ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትማስን ።
verses.translation: In order, then, that we die not before thee, and the land be made desolate, buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharao: give seed that we may sow, and live and not die, so our land shall not be made desolate.

translations.lxx: In order, then, that we die not before thee, and the land be made desolate, buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharao: give seed that we may sow, and live and not die, so our land shall not be made desolate.
translations.kjv: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.
translations.ron: De ce să pierim sub ochii tăi şi noi şi pământurile noastre? Cumpără-ne pe pâine, pe noi cu pământurile noastre, şi vom fi robi lui Faraon, noi şi pământurile noastre, iar tu să ne dai sămânţă ca să trăim şi să nu murim şi ca ogoarele să nu rămână paragină".
translations.grk: ἵνα οὖν μὴ ἀποθάνωμεν ἐναντίον σου, καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐρημωθῇ, κτῆσαι ἡμᾶς καὶ τὴν γῆν ἡμῶν ἀντὶ ἄρτων, καὶ ἐσόμεθα ἡμεῖς καὶ ἡ γῆ ἡμῶν παῖδες τῷ Φαραώ· δὸς σπέρμα, ἵνα σπείρωμεν, καὶ ζῶμεν καὶ μὴ ἀποθάνωμεν, καὶ ἡ γῆ οὐκ ἐρημωθήσεται.

verses.geez:
ወአጥረየ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ምድሮሙ ፡ ለግብጽ ፡ ወአግብአ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ምድሮሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀየሎሙ ፡ ረኃብ ፡
                  ወኮነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ምድር ፡ ለፈርዖን ።
verses.translation: And Joseph bought all the land of the Egyptians, for Pharao; for the Egyptians sold their land to Pharao; for the famine prevailed against them, and the land became Pharao's.

translations.lxx: And Joseph bought all the land of the Egyptians, for Pharao; for the Egyptians sold their land to Pharao; for the famine prevailed against them, and the land became Pharao's.
translations.kjv: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh’s.
translations.ron: Şi a cumpărat Iosif pentru Faraon tot pământul Egiptului, pentru că Egiptenii şi-au vândut fiecare pământul său lui Faraon, că-i istovise foametea; şi a ajuns tot pământul al lui Faraon.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκτήσατο Ἰωσὴφ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν τῶν Αἰγυπτίων τῷ Φαραώ· ἀπέδοντο γὰρ οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν τῷ Φαραώ· ἐπεκράτησε γὰρ αὐτῶν ὁ λιμός· καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ γῆ τῷ Φαραώ.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ኮንዎ ፡ አግብርቲሁ ፡ ወቀነዮሙ ፡ እምአጽናፈ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወአድባሪሆሙኒ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለግብጽ
                  ፡ እምአጽናፈ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፤
verses.translation: And he brought the people into bondage to him, for servants, from one extremity of Egypt to the other,

translations.lxx: And he brought the people into bondage to him, for servants, from one extremity of Egypt to the other,
translations.kjv: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.
translations.ron: De asemenea şi pe popor l-a făcut rob lui, de la un capăt al Egiptului până la celălalt.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸν λαὸν κατεδουλώσατο αὐτῷ εἰς παῖδας, ἀπʼ ἄκρων ὁρίων Αἰγύπτου ἕως τῶν ἄκρων,

verses.geez:
ዘእንበለ ፡ ምድሮሙ ፡ ለማርያን ፡ ባሕቲታ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢያጥረየ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ እስመ ፡ ወሀቦሙ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ለማርያን ፡
                  ወፈተቶሙ ፡ ወጸገዎሙ ፡ ወበእንተዝ ፡ ኢሤጡ ፡ ምድሮሙ ።
verses.translation: except only the land of the priests; Joseph bought not this, for Pharao gave a portion in the way of gift to the priests; and they ate their portion which Pharao gave them; therefore they sold not their land.

translations.lxx: except only the land of the priests; Joseph bought not this, for Pharao gave a portion in the way of gift to the priests; and they ate their portion which Pharao gave them; therefore they sold not their land.
translations.kjv: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.
translations.ron: Numai pământurile preoţilor nu le-a cumpărat Iosif, căci preoţilor le era rânduită de la Faraon porţie şi se hrăneau din porţia lor, pe care le-o da Faraon; de aceea nu şi-au vândut ei pământul.
translations.grk: χωρὶς τῆς γῆς τῶν ἱερέων μόνον· οὐκ ἐκτήσατο ταύτην Ἰωσήφ· ἐν δόσει γὰρ ἔδωκε δόμα τοῖς ἱερεῦσι Φαραὼ, καὶ ἤσθιον τὴν δόσιν, ἣν ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς Φαραώ· διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἀπέδοντο τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ተሣየጥኩክሙ ፡ ኪያክሙሂ ፡ ወምድርክሙሂ ፡ ለፈርዖን
                  ፡ ንሥኡ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ወዝርእዋ ፡ ለምድርክሙ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph said to all the Egyptians, Behold, I have bought you and your land this day for Pharao; take seed for you, and sow the land.

translations.lxx: And Joseph said to all the Egyptians, Behold, I have bought you and your land this day for Pharao; take seed for you, and sow the land.
translations.kjv: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.
translations.ron: Atunci a zis Iosif către popor: "Iată, eu v-am cumpărat astăzi pentru Faraon şi pe voi şi pământul vostru. Luaţi-vă sămânţă şi semănaţi pământul.
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Ἰωσὴφ πᾶσι τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις, ἰδοὺ κέκτημαι ὑμᾶς καὶ τὴν γῆν ὑμῶν σήμερον τῷ Φαραῷ· λάβετε ἑαυτοῖς σπέρμα, καὶ σπείρατε τὴν γῆν.

verses.geez:
ወታገብኡ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ እክለ ፡ ኃምስተ ፡ እደ ፡ (ክፍለ ፡) ወአርባዕተ ፡ እደ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ዘይከውነክሙ ፡ ዘርአ ፡
                  ለምድርክሙ ፡ ወለሲሳይክሙ ፡ ወለሲሳየ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሰብእክሙ ።
verses.translation: And there shall be the fruits of it; and ye shall give the fifth part to Pharao, and the four remaining parts shall be for yourselves, for seed for the earth, and for food for you, and all that are in your houses.

translations.lxx: And there shall be the fruits of it; and ye shall give the fifth part to Pharao, and the four remaining parts shall be for yourselves, for seed for the earth, and for food for you, and all that are in your houses.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.
translations.ron: Şi la seceriş să daţi a cincea parte lui Faraon, iar patru părţi să vă rămână vouă pentru semănatul ogoarelor, pentru hrana voastră şi a celor ce sunt în casele voastre şi pentru hrana copiilor voştri".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται τὰ γεννήματα αὐτῆς· καὶ δώσετε τὸ πεμπτὸν μέρος τῷ Φαραώ· τὰ δὲ τέσσαρα μέρη ἔσται ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς εἰς σπέρμα τῇ γῇ, καὶ εἰς βρῶσιν ὑμῖν, καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις ὑμῶν.

verses.geez: ወይቤልዎ ፡ አሕየውከነ ፡ ወረከብነ ፡ ሞገሰ ፡ በቅድሜሁ ፡ ለእግዚእነ ፡ ወኮነ ፡ አግብርተ ፡ ለፈርዖን ።
verses.translation: And they said, Thou hast saved us; we have found favour before our lord, and we will be servants to Pharao.

translations.lxx: And they said, Thou hast saved us; we have found favour before our lord, and we will be servants to Pharao.
translations.kjv: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.
translations.ron: Iar ei au zis: "Tu ne-ai salvat viaţa! Să aflăm milă în ochii domnului nostru şi să fim robi lui Faraon!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπαν, σέσωκας ἡμᾶς· εὕρομεν χάριν ἐναντίον τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν, καὶ ἐσόμεθα παῖδες τῷ Φαραώ.

verses.geez:
ወኮነት ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ሥርዐት ፡ እንተ ፡ ሠርዐ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወቆመት ፡ እስከ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡
                  ከመ ፡ ያግብኡ ፡ ኃምስተ ፡ እደ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ እስከ ፡ ዮም ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ማርያን ፡ ባሕቲታ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢኮነት
                  ፡ ለፈርዖን ።
verses.translation: And Joseph appointed it to them for an ordinance until this day; to reserve a fifth part for Pharao, on the land of Egypt, except only the land of the priests, that was not Pharao's.

translations.lxx: And Joseph appointed it to them for an ordinance until this day; to reserve a fifth part for Pharao, on the land of Egypt, except only the land of the priests, that was not Pharao's.
translations.kjv: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh’s.
translations.ron: Şi le-a pus Iosif lege, care-i până astăzi în ţara Egiptului, ca a cincea parte să se dea lui Faraon, scutit fiind numai pământul preoţilor, care nu era al lui Faraon.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔθετο αὐτοῖς Ἰωσὴφ εἰς πρόσταγμα ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης, ἐπὶ γῆς Αἰγύπτου τῷ Φαραὼ ἀποπεμπτοῦν, χωρὶς τῆς γῆς τῶν ἱερέων μόνον· οὐκ ἧν τῷ Φαραώ.

verses.geez: ወነበረ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጌሴም ፡ ወኮነት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ክፍሎሙ ፡ ወበዝኁ ፡ ወመልኡ ፡ ጥቀ ።
verses.translation: And Israel dwelt in Egypt, in the land of Gesem, and they gained an inheritance upon it; and they increased and multiplied very greatly.

translations.lxx: And Israel dwelt in Egypt, in the land of Gesem, and they gained an inheritance upon it; and they increased and multiplied very greatly.
translations.kjv: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.
translations.ron: Astfel s-a aşezat Israel în ţara Egiptului, în ţinutul Goşen, şi l-a moştenit şi a crescut şi s-a înmulţit foarte tare.
translations.grk: Κατῶκησε δὲ Ἰσραὴλ ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ ἐπὶ γῆς Γεσὲμ, καὶ ἐκληρονόμησαν ἐπʼ αὐτῆς· καὶ ηὐξήθησαν καὶ ἐπληθύνθησαν σφόδρα.

verses.geez:
ወሐይወ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ዐሠርተ ፡ ወሰባዕተ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ወኮነ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ሕይወቱ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ ምእተ
                  ፡ ወአርብዓ ፡ ወ[ሰባዕት ፡] ዓመተ ።
verses.translation: And Jacob survived seventeen years in the land of Egypt; and Jacob's days of the years of his life were a hundred and forty-seven years.

translations.lxx: And Jacob survived seventeen years in the land of Egypt; and Jacob's days of the years of his life were a hundred and forty-seven years.
translations.kjv: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.
translations.ron: Iacov a mai trăit în ţara Egiptului şaptesprezece ani. Zilele vieţii lui Iacov au fost deci o sută patruzeci şi şapte de ani.
translations.grk: Ἐπέζησε δὲ Ἰακὼβ ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ δεκαεπτὰ ἔτη· καὶ ἐγένοντο αἱ ἡμέραι Ἰακὼβ ἐνιαυτῶν τῆς ζωῆς αὐτοῦ ἑκατὸν τεσσαρακονταεπτὰ ἔτη.

verses.geez:
ወቀርበ ፡ መዋዕሊሁ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ለመዊት ፡ ወጸውዖ ፡ ለወልዱ ፡ [ዮሴፍ ፡] ወይቤሎ ፡ እመ ፡ ረከብኩ ፡ ሞገሰ ፡
                  ቅድሜከ ፡ ደይ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሥጋየ ፡ ወግበር ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ምሕረተ ፡ ወጽድቀ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትቅብረኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብጽ
                  ።
verses.translation: And the days of Israel drew nigh for him to die: and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, If I have found favour before thee, put thy hand under my thigh, and thou shalt execute mercy and truth toward me, so as not to bury me in Egypt.

translations.lxx: And the days of Israel drew nigh for him to die: and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, If I have found favour before thee, put thy hand under my thigh, and thou shalt execute mercy and truth toward me, so as not to bury me in Egypt.
translations.kjv: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:
translations.ron: Apoi venindu-i lui vremea să moară, Israel a chemat pe fiul său Iosif, şi i-a zis: "De am aflat har în ochii tăi, pune-ţi mâna pe coapsa mea şi jură că vei face milă şi dreptate cu mine, să nu mă îngropi în Egipt!
translations.grk: Ἤγγισαν δὲ αἱ ἡμέραι Ἰσραὴλ τοῦ ἀποθανεῖν· καὶ ἐκάλεσε τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ Ἰωσὴφ, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, εἰ εὕρηκα χάριν ἐναντίον σου, ὑπόθες τὴν χεῖρά σου ὑπὸ τὸν μηρόν μου, καὶ ποιήσεις ἐπʼ ἐμὲ ἐλεημοσύνην, καὶ ἀλήθειαν, τοῦ μή με θάψαι ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ·

verses.geez:
ዳእሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ እኑም ፡ ምስለ ፡ አበዊየ ፡ ወአውጽአኒ ፡ እምነ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወቅብረኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መቃብሮሙ ፡
                  ለአበዊየ ፤ ወይቤሎ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ኦሆ ፡ እገብር ፡ በከመ ፡ ትቤ ።
verses.translation: But I will sleep with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me up out of Egypt, and bury me in their sepulchre. And he said, I will do according to thy word.

translations.lxx: But I will sleep with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me up out of Egypt, and bury me in their sepulchre. And he said, I will do according to thy word.
translations.kjv: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.
translations.ron: Când voi adormi ca părinţii mei, mă vei scoate din Egipt şi mă vei îngropa în mormântul lor". Iar Iosif a zis: "Voi face după cuvântul tău!"
translations.grk: Ἀλλὰ κοιμηθήσομαι μετὰ τῶν πατέρων μου· καὶ ἀρεῖς με ἐξ Αἰγύπτου, καὶ θάψεις με ἐν τῷ τάφῳ αὐτῶν· ὁ δὲ εἶπεν, ἐγὼ ποιήσω κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ መሐልኬ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ወመሐለ ፡ ሎቴ ፡ ወሰገደ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከተማ ፡ በትሩ ።
verses.translation: And he said, Swear to me; and he swore to him. And Israel did reverence, leaning on the top of his staff.

translations.lxx: And he said, Swear to me; and he swore to him. And Israel did reverence, leaning on the top of his staff.
translations.kjv: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed’s head.
translations.ron: Iacov însă a zis: "Jură-mi!" Şi i s-a jurat Iosif. Atunci Israel s-a închinat la vârful toiagului său.
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ, ὄμοσόν μοι· καὶ ὤμοσεν αὐτῷ· καὶ προσεκύνησεν Ἰσραὴλ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τῆς ῥάβδου αὐτοῦ.
